activity_summary: At the morning rehearsal Garnish kept the tally at twenty-four and refused to tick a scrap Kemp sang at a bench. You agreed the song, if it was a song, belonged to the afternoon yard. Nick had the watchet gown and the Princess's old words, and you gave him nothing new. Burbage told you to leave the ending. You left the new lines unwritten.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Held the tally at twenty-four and gave Nick no new line.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Tried a scrap and was told to wait for the yard.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Would not tick a parlour tune, and said twenty-four once more.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Defended the hour, and told you to leave the last page.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Showed the watchet, said the voice still held, and agreed not to decorate.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in Not a parlour tune

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: Twenty-four stands. I had it at breakfast and I have it now.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: Bring it to the yard this afternoon, whole, in front of the holiday

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Twenty-four is the tally until the yard changes it.
